|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 3 December 2025<ref name="ht-7b60eb1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/welcomehomelordtyranus.gif</code> as published 3 December 2025: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7b60eb19805b2c6100b4b2c088c426096e242e90/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/welcomehomelordtyranus.gif holotable commit 7b60eb1] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If Dooku is your apprentice, choose: Take Petranaki Arena or The Works into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If Dooku and Sidious on table, cancel Sense. OR Once per game, if Darth Tyranus in battle at a site and you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, instead use his ability number.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 26 December 2025: “If Dooku is your apprentice, choose: Take Petranaki Arena or The Works into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If Dooku and Sidious on table, cancel Sense. OR Once per game, if Darth Tyranus in battle at a site and you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, instead use his ability number.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus]] (published 3 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
